title: 1 Home | KEY.co
description_expanded: Inside, the mansion offers a sanctuary of indulgence with a private speakeasy, adorned with a 12-foot LED TV and high-end sound system, setting the stage for exclusive soirées. The lower level reveals a spa retreat, complete with a 20-person steam room, sauna, and soaking tub, offering a private haven for rejuvenation. Accommodations are equally opulent, including six elegantly appointed bedrooms across the main and guest houses, each ensuring utmost comfort and privacy. Situated just moments from Scottsdale's premier shopping, dining, and nightlife, and a mere 15-minute walk from Camelback Mountain trailhead, this estate offers both the seclusion of a private retreat and the convenience of city life, making it the perfect escape for those seeking to experience Scottsdale in unparalleled luxury and style. Nestled in the heart of Scottsdale, this stunning 10,000 square foot three-story modern mansion presents an unparalleled blend of luxury and elegance, freshly completed and waiting to welcome those with a taste for the finer things in life. Designed for both lavish entertainment and tranquil relaxation, the property boasts an impressive 6,000 square foot rooftop deck, offering an outdoor kitchen and dining area perfect for al fresco gatherings against the breathtaking backdrop of Camelback Mountain. The estate's expansive grounds invite guests to luxuriate by the heated pool and spa, engage in playful lawn games, or unwind in the serene ambiance provided by the outdoor fireplace, crafting an idyllic setting for creating unforgettable memories.
